name: baseline
description: Acceptance testing for any web app, inside Claude Code. Point it at a PR, ticket or spec and a URL. It reads the code, walks the site as your test users, and reports where spec, code and site disagree.

jira_base_url.title: Jira base URL
jira_base_url.description: For example https://acme.atlassian.net. Only needed for Jira tickets when no Jira connector is set up.

jira_email.title: Jira account email
jira_email.description: The email of the Jira account the token belongs to.

jira_token.title: Jira API token
jira_token.description: A Jira API token. Stored in your system's secure credential store.

linear_api_key.title: Linear API key
linear_api_key.description: Only needed for Linear issues when no Linear connector is set up. Stored in your system's secure credential store.
